action.content:
Are you currently trying to figure out how to split your last $400 while also dealing with a spouse who thinks you're still the CEO of their ex-husband's startup? Look no further than **Divorce Dave**, the only attorney in town who actually understands that your primary asset right now is your dignity, not your 401(k).

Most lawyers charge you thousands of dollars just to tell you to "go home and pack your bags." That sounds like a lot of money for someone who is currently living in a cardboard box and eating instant noodles for dinner. But not me! I believe in **legal justice for the underdog**, even if that underdog is also trying to find a job that doesn't require a degree.

I don't care if you have a credit score lower than your ex's patience. I will fight for your custody rights, your right to keep your cat, and your right to not be sued by your ex for "emotional damages." My fees are so low, **you might actually be able to afford them**, which is a miracle in itself. So, stop crying into your pillow and call me today. Let's get you out of this mess before you accidentally sign a document that makes you legally responsible for their dog's insurance premiums.
